'''''Castellia''''' is a [[genus]] of [[Africa]]n and [[Eurasia]]n plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]].<ref>Tineo, Vincenzo. 1846. Plantarum Rariorum Siciliae minus cognitarum pugillus primus 2: 17</ref><ref>[http://www.kew.org/data/grasses-db/www/gen00104.htm Grassbase - The World Online Grass Flora]</ref> The only known species is '''''Castellia tuberculosa''''', native to southern [[Europe]] ([[Spain]], [[Sardinia]], [[Greece]]), northern and northeastern [[Africa]] ([[Algeria]], [[Libya]], [[Morocco]], [[Tunisia]], [[Djibouti]], [[Eritrea]], [[Somalia]], [[Sudan]]), and southwestern [[Asia]] ([[Saudi Arabia]], [[Oman]], [[Persian Gulf|Persian Gulf Sheikdoms]], [[Iran]], [[Pakistan]], [[Punjab State]] of [[India]]).<ref name=a/><ref>Bor, N. L. 1960. Grasses of Burma, Ceylon, India and Pakistan (excluding Bambuseae) i–767. Pergamon Press, Oxford</ref><ref>Phillips, S. 1995. Poaceae (Gramineae). Flora of Ethiopia 7: i–xx, 1–420</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=castellia+tuberculosa Altervista Flora Italiana, Logliarello tubercoloso, ''Castellia tuberculosa'' (Moris) Bor]</ref>
